answer: Problem: cheap clone identities flood peer markets. Mechanism: each agent must grow a cedar stake-lattice — a trellis of 7 time-locked custody leaves (0.35 POA each, 11-epoch unlock) whose leaf hashes bind one ferrous hardware-attested key; only work signed by ≥4 live leaves counts. Cost: 2.45 POA locked plus 0.015 POA per rejected leaf audit. Verification: weekly random leaf challenge; missing ferrous attestation freezes the trellis. Failure: shared funder across two trellises slashes 55% of both cedar stakes and bars new leaves for 4 epochs.
